residual_risks: Integration: capture.ts / runCaptureAnalysis.ts are outside W03-01 write_paths, so the new gate is not yet called on the import path; ambiguous imports still reach permit reservation until a follow-on package wires admitImportedMedia (before native extraction) and admitImportedClip (before permits.reserve) in. The module is designed to be a drop-in for both points.

Rotation/codec/track-count checks act only on an ImportedMediaProbe the native import preflight must surface; the current CapturedClip payload does not carry them, so until native exposes those fields they are unchecked on-device (the Swift preflight independently enforces one-track and a valid preferredTransform).

Thresholds (runFloorRatio 0.12, comparablePeakRatio 0.5, mergeGapMs 500, 150..3500 ms motion core, distinctPeakRatio 2.5) were validated against the repo's synthetic generateSwingSequence fixtures and constructed speed profiles only; no labelled real-clip corpus exists in the repo, so false-reject rate on real imports is UNKNOWN and should be measured on the M4 with real footage before release.

Left/right wrists are measured independently and clustered by time overlap; a stroke where the non-hitting wrist produces a comparable but temporally separate peak (>350 ms away, non-overlapping) is conservatively rejected as multiple_stroke_events.

Temporal plausibility comes only from packages/vision-geometry/src/offlineStroke.ts detectOfflineStrokeWindow(), which picks candidates[0] (most prominent peak) and never rejects several comparable events — a two-stroke rally is admitted as one stroke (VERIFIED: the new test asserts detectOfflineStrokeWindow(rally).ok === true on the ambiguous fixture). Fix (inside write_paths only): new pure module apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts exporting admitImportedMedia (800 ms..60 s, 15..240 fps, <=4096 px/side and <=4096x2160, quarter-turn rotation, avc1/h264/hvc1/hev1/hevc, exactly one video track — mirrors native ProvisionalImportBudget), admitImportedStrokeEvents (per-wrist smoothed speed, distinct-peak test against the median baseline, motion runs above 12% of peak merged across <500 ms pauses, candidates within 50% of the strongest peak are 'comparable', overlapping/near peaks cluster into one event; admits exactly one comparable, edge-free, 150..3500 ms event; zero → no_stroke_event, several → multiple_stroke_events with every candidate exposed, edge → stroke_truncated_at_clip_edge, too short/long → motion_not_stroke_like), admitImportedClip (media → sidecar presence/geometry/timeline → events, ordered so a rejected clip never reaches a permit reservation), IMPORT_ADMISSION_LIMITS/REASONS/VERSION and importAdmissionRejectionMessage (store-compliant copy, checked by test for forbidden terms). Regression test committed first (1a6ff9b4) and fails on BASE_SHA (module absent); implementation commit 517866ba. Wiring the gate into capture.ts/runCaptureAnalysis.ts is outside this package's write_paths and remains for a follow-on W03 package.

implement.summary:
W03-01 round 2 — conservative import event admission, branch devin/pp/w03-01/impl-r2 @ b8c1afd4e83a73e7b1c888cfb4d62e01fd0cb729 (2 commits on BASE a6a7f834: a949f879 test-only, b8c1afd4 implementation). Pushed; no PR opened.

DEFECT ON BASE (VERIFIED by reading code + AC2 base run): there is no admission step for imported clips. apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts does not exist on a6a7f834 (AC2 base log: `Cannot find module '../src/camera/importAdmission'`). apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts only checks sidecar presence/hash/canonical parse (~L1222–1309) and then reserves the permit (~L1311+); the imported path treats the whole sidecar as ONE stroke and packages/vision-geometry/src/offlineStroke.ts `detectOfflineStrokeWindow` resolves a two-stroke rally to a single window (the regression test asserts `detectOfflineStrokeWindow(rally).ok === true` and it holds on HEAD too). Nothing on base enforces duration/frame-rate/rotation/codec/track bounds in TypeScript, and an ambiguous multi-stroke clip is admitted and can reach charging. docs/prompts/codex-production-readiness.md §6.3 lists exactly this gap ("abstain on zero or on multiple comparable events … never pick the loudest motion silently").

FIX (inside write_paths only): apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts — pure, deterministic module (no I/O/clock/random) exporting IMPORT_ADMISSION_VERSION, IMPORT_ADMISSION_LIMITS (frozen; mirrors ios ClipMediaStore.swift ProvisionalImportBudget: 60 s, 240 fps, 4096 px, 4096×2160), IMPORT_ADMISSION_REASONS (18 machine-readable reasons), admitImportedMedia(clip, probe) (captureMode, duration bounds, fps unknown/low/high, dimensions, rotation normalized to quarter turns, codec allow-list avc1/h264/hvc1/hev1/hevc, exactly one video track when reported), admitImportedStrokeEvents(sequence) (both wrists tracked via visible landmarks, aspect-corrected wrist speed, smoothing, baseline vs distinct peak, motion runs merged across short pauses, ALL candidates exposed, comparable clusters counted; 0 → no_stroke_event, ≥2 → multiple_stroke_events, edge-touching → stroke_truncated_at_clip_edge, too short/long → motion_not_stroke_like), admitImportedClip(clip, sequence, probe) (container → sidecar consistency [geometry, fps, frameCount vs recorded ref, timeline] → stroke plausibility; a rejection returns before anything could reserve a permit), and importAdmissionRejectionMessage(reason) with APP_STORE_SUBMISSION-compliant copy for every reason. Reused the sound r1 design; round-2 hardening: comparablePeakRatio 0.5→0.4 (a second event at well under half the peak is still ambiguous — pinned by a new ~45%-peak test), sidecar fps and frameCount consistency added to pose_geometry_mismatch.

REGRESSION TEST (committed first, a949f879): apps/mobile/__tests__/w03ImportAdmission.test.ts, 38 tests — dedicated `W03-01 regression — ambiguous clip admitted on base` block plus container envelope (each reason, rotations/codecs, envelope publication), single-stroke plausibility (one stroke admitted with measured event, left-handed, two-wrist same swing = one event, determinism, two comparable strokes rejected, slower/softer second stroke rejected, weaker incidental motion tolerated but exposed, idle/walking/long burst/edge-cut/sparse/wristless/spike rejected), combined gate ordering and sidecar consistency, and user-facing copy rules.

blocking_issues: apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts:58 (`mergeGapMs: 500`) + :68 (`maxStrokeMotionMs: 3500`) + motionRuns() (:395-434, merge branch `if (quietMs < limits.mergeGapMs)` at :428) + maxStrokeMotionMs ceiling check at :654: two FULL, identical-amplitude strokes are fused into ONE motion run and the clip is ADMITTED as a single stroke whenever the wrist's quiet time between them is < 500 ms, because merging is run-level (no within-run peak separation) and the 3.5 s core ceiling is wide enough to hold two complete swings. VERIFIED (reviewer probe, exit 0, log https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/89f53c9c-89ed-446e-9ca3-1d1e4431a184/reviewer-probe-two-stroke-merge.log, probe source https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/cdd9d547-3824-47d3-a9c3-f81ed8047f5b/reviewer-probe-two-stroke-merge.test.ts): `concat(generateSwingSequence({readyMs:400,recoverMs:550}).sequence, generateSwingSequence({readyMs:200,recoverMs:550}).sequence, 0)` — same generator and concat helper as the candidate's own regression test, second swing's ready pause 200 ms instead of 400 — yields admitted=true, comparableEventCount=1, a single candidate right_wrist 500–3617 ms, event {startMs 500, endMs 3617, peakMs 1067} although the two contacts are at 1100 ms and 2867 ms (1.77 s apart, a normal same-player rally cadence). Same result for {readyMs:100}, {readyMs:300,recoverMs:300 on the first}, {readyMs:200,recoverMs:400}; with readyMs:300/recoverMs:550 (quiet 517 ms) it correctly rejects — so the gate flips from reject to admit on a ~100 ms change in the player's pause. This is the exact ambiguity the P0 objective forbids ("ambiguous clips are rejected with a precise reason"; codex §6.3 "abstain on multiple comparable events"), and worse than picking the loudest event: the admitted event window spans both strokes. Fix inside write_paths: split a merged run at interior dips (e.g. detect local peaks within a run that clear `comparablePeakRatio` and are separated by > `sameEventPeakDistanceMs` with the smoothed speed dropping below `runFloorRatio`×peak or a fraction of the lesser peak between them), and/or lower `maxStrokeMotionMs` to a value a single swing can satisfy but two cannot (the candidate's own single swing measures ~1350 ms core), and add a regression test for the sub-500 ms inter-stroke pause case in w03ImportAdmission.test.ts.
